headline: Two reads landed this afternoon and both were passes — but one of them exposed a Monday showing on 821 Martinwood that no board was tracking, and it says 'too high.' Tomorrow is the Lake Crest inspection at 9:00 and a second showing on a house that's already clear-to-close. Nine showings still owe reads and you owe feedback on 7 homes you toured.

hotSignals.action: Call Chesley C. tonight. When the other side is talking to your client and your client has no answer from you, you are not running the negotiation anymore.
